title: Density scaling test vectors
description: Shared cross-impl test vectors for density-adaptive parameters. Vectors needed: (1) announce parameter selection at each density tier (sparse/moderate/dense/very-dense/extreme), (2) gradient timeout matching announce interval, (3) num_slots scaling from DODAG size, (4) position beacon rate at each density tier. Place in test/vectors/. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.4, §9.10.
